entry.title: Librarian Tidy Up the Arcane Library v3.0.2
entry.content:
## Librarian-AP v3.0.2
Traps, a higher spare book percent for custom goals, and four fixes.
**Existing runs keep working.** Install over 3.0.1 and reconnect. The end door fix works on a run in progress; the other three fixes and the new options need a seed generated with the new apworld. A 3.0.1 YAML still works, but see the trap note below.
## New: traps
Traps are items that make things harder for a short while. They take the place of filler, never of anything a check or your goal depends on, and nothing a trap does is saved into your game.
**Traps are on by default.** A YAML that says nothing about them gets about 10% of its filler turned into traps, and that includes a 3.0.1 YAML regenerated with the new apworld. Set `trap_percentage: 0` for a seed with none.
```yaml trap_percentage: 10 # 0-100, default 10 trap_weights: # how often each one comes up; 0 turns it off Fatigue: 2 Floor Shuffle: 2 Veil: 2 Butterfingers: 2 Scramble Shelf: 1 Shelf Spill: 1 ```
| Trap | What it does | |---|---| | Fatigue | One magic skill recovers slowly for two minutes. | | Floor Shuffle | The loose books lying on the floor swap places with each other. | | Veil | The loose books you could pick up are hidden for 30 seconds, then come back. | | Butterfingers | Some of the books in your hands, from one up to all of them, fall beside you in a pile. | | Scramble Shelf | A few books in a row you have not finished trade places. | | Shelf Spill | A few books in a row you have not finished fall out onto the floor in front of their bookcase. |
The shelf traps never touch a finished row, so a completed row and its check stay done. Their notice says which bookcase and row they hit, for example "Scramble Shelf: 2 books on bookcase 2J, row 1 are out of order", and says so when one is skipped because you are carrying books or the shelves are empty. A notice shows on screen when a trap takes effect. In the multiworld the items end in "Trap", for example `Veil Trap` and `Sort Fatigue Trap`.
**Fatigue changed.** In 3.0.1 every seed had a fixed set of up to ten Fatigue items. Fatigue is now one of the traps above, so how many you get follows `trap_percentage` and its weight.
## New: higher `spare_book_item_percent` on custom goals
```yaml spare_book_item_percent: 10 # 0-100, default 10 ```
The range goes up to 100. Past 20 it only works on `goal: custom`, and only when the host allows it (`allow_high_spare_book_percent` in `host.yaml`, off by default). Other goals are held at 20.
## Fix: you could leave through the end door before your goal
Once every book you had unlocked was shelved, the game let you leave through the library door and play the ending before your Archipelago goal was reached. The door now stays shut until the goal is reached.
## Fix: individual book unlocks with count checks never showed any books
With `unlock_mode: individual_book_unlocks` and `check_mode: count`, the books you received never appeared. Seeds generated with the new apworld reveal them as they arrive.
## Fix: booksanity milestones were in logic from the start
With `check_mode: booksanity`, the "Correctly shelve N books" checks (with series unlocks) and, on floor and custom goals, the Reached Level checks past what the seed's rows can reach were in logic from the start, so the tracker showed them early and items could be placed on them out of reach. New seeds gate them by the books and rows you can actually shelve.
## Fix: random book bundles all came from the two starting sections
With `unlock_mode: random_book_bundle` and `bookcase_unlocks: unlocked`, the first bundles all came from the two starting sections instead of from across the library. Seeds generated with the new apworld draw every bundle from the whole library.
## Updating
> Extract the zip and drop `Librarian/` into your Steam install (overwrite). Drop > `librarian.apworld` into your Archipelago `custom_worlds/` folder. **Both are required.** > The title screen should read `LibAP v3.0.2`.
## If something breaks
Press F8, then send that session's log from `Mods\Librarian-AP\logs\`, your YAML's `Librarian:` section, and one line on what you were doing.

entry.title: Death's Door v0.4.2
entry.content:
# Death's Door Archipelago 0.4.2
Use apworld 0.4.2 together with mod 0.4.2. Seeds generated with apworld 0.4.0 or 0.4.1 also work with mod 0.4.2.
## Mod (ArchipelagoRandomizer 0.4.2)
### Skip Cutscenes - The late-game story scenes are now skipped, including on saves that are already under way: - the Grey Crow opening Death's Door - the Grey Crow and Death in the void - Death's talk after the Grey Crow fight - the crows' scene in the Hall of Doors - the Lord of Doors' speeches before the gauntlet and during the final fight - The camera pans that show what you just opened are now skipped too. These include the Castle Lockstone braziers, the Lost Cemetery ghosts, crow souls flying into an Ancient Door, and doors, levers and cleared fights. - The ending after the Lord of Doors and the credits still play. - The few cutscenes that can leave invisible walls behind are always skipped, whether or not Skip Cutscenes is on.
### Shop - With Shop Hints on, looking at a stat in the shop shows the item its next upgrade holds and hints it. - Progressive Strength, Dexterity, Haste and Magic now show the shop's stat icons, in white, in popups and in the Recent Items list.
### Door and stat tracker - While the game is paused, press Tab (keyboard) or Y (controller) to open a tracker panel. A small hint in the bottom-left of the pause menu shows this: - With entrance randomization, the doors of the area you're in and where each one leads once you've been through it. In coupled seeds the way back counts too. Page Up / Page Down or the triggers show other areas. - With Shop Upgrades on, the level you've received for each stat and how many of its upgrades you've bought. - The shop's description panel now shows your current level of each stat. The shop's bars only show what you bought.
### DeathLink - Fixed the game crashing when it received a DeathLink. - A DeathLink that arrives while you're rolling, invincible or just respawned is no longer lost. It kills you as soon as it can. - Fixed your own deaths sometimes not being sent after you received a DeathLink. - A DeathLink that arrives while you're already dead no longer kills you again after respawning. - The game now shows who caused a DeathLink when it kills you.
### Fixes - Fixed a possible crash when the connection to the server drops. - The Grove of Spirits Door check is now sent when you arrive in the Hall of Doors, even with Skip Cutscenes off. - Fixed short freezes when planting a Life Seed in a new pot. They happened even with planting checks off. - Fixed a freeze in entrance randomizer seeds when a door led to another door in the same area, such as one Hall of Doors door to another. - Fixed a bug in ItemChanger that logged an error every frame in some areas. This made log files grow to over 100 MB and could cause stutter.
## APWorld (deaths_door 0.4.2) - Every Life Seed now counts towards the logic. The tracker now shows the Green Tablet and the goal as reachable once you've planted enough seeds. - On the Universal Tracker map: - Planting pot pins follow each pot's own requirements. The Crypt pot needs Fire. - The Imp Loft pot pin has moved to the Ceramic Manor left wing. - The "Beat the Lord of Doors" and "Open the Green Ancient Tablet Door" pins only light up once you can actually do them. - Entrance randomizer never connects two Hall of Doors doors to each other. - Grunt's Old Mask is no longer shown as glitched in the tracker when you can actually get it. - Leaving Ceramic Manor through the gate to the Estate of the Urn Witch is now in logic. The gate opens from the inside, day or night. - Universal Tracker's `/get_logical_path <place>` now lists the doors to take from the Hall of Doors, in order, with where each one actually leads in your seed. It only uses doors you've been through and paths you can walk with your current items. - New option **Shop Hints** (on by default). It controls the shop preview and hints described above. - Corrected the descriptions of Extra Life Seeds and Planted Pots Required.
## README - The mod and apworld READMEs are now one README, attached to this release and included in the mod zip. It covers setup from start to finish, every in-game Mod Option and every yaml option, including the new shop and planting options.

entry.title: Super Crazy Rhythm Castle v0.29.0r2
entry.content:
# v0.29.2 � Cell Tower escape fixes
**October 22, 2026. Client 0.76.2 / APWorld 0.29.0 (unchanged).**
## Fixed
- Cell Tower Access now keeps the return gate from the Central Mainframe room toward the Cell Tower phone usable, including its interaction, before the native level-attempt requirement is met. - Leaving that room toward Lobby before Fish Tears delivery now returns the player safely to Music Lab, avoiding the upper-Lobby hand-blocker trap. After delivery, the normal route remains subject to existing area ownership checks. - These repairs do not complete quests, grant items, send checks or change generated progression rules.
## Updating
Close the game and install **RhythmCastleAP-v0.76.2.zip**, retaining its included licenses. Keep your configuration, current seed and associated save. APWorld remains **0.29.0**; the unchanged APWorld download is included for convenience. No regeneration or tracker update is required for this client patch.
## Validation and scope
Both reported escape routes passed targeted user gameplay testing. The release contains the accepted native-interaction repair with a version-label update. Native-reference tests cover exact condition validation, idempotence, wrong flags/classes and failed writes; existing routing regressions are also covered. Full release validation is recorded in [testing](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.2/docs/TESTING.md).
Separate investigation confirmed early Violance did not prevent Old Tom's note in the tested post-nectar state, and the Cell Tower Star Eater did not require Cold Storage completion after leaving and returning. Complete prerequisites are not yet isolated, so generation logic remains unchanged.
Intermittent performance stalls, extended-session/multiplayer coverage and remaining native-rule uncertainties remain in [known issues](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.2/docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md). This release does not claim to resolve those reports.
See the [AI disclosure](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.2/docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md) and [gate acceptance record](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.2/docs/testing/2026-10-22-hub-escape.md).
Release validation: all 45 client regression projects passed, the Release build completed with zero warnings/errors, repository validation passed, and all 10 packaging tests passed. The APWorld asset is reused byte-for-byte from v0.29.1.

entry.content:
## AEMinecraft v0.7.0-rc.4
**Pre-release.** Fourth test build of v0.7.0. Stay on v0.6.2 if you want a stable game.
This RC only lists what changed since the **[v0.7.0-rc.3 release notes](https://github.com/KuroLynx/AEMinecraft/releases/tag/v0.7.0-rc.3)**. For everything new in v0.7.0, see the **[v0.7.0-rc.1 release notes](https://github.com/KuroLynx/AEMinecraft/releases/tag/v0.7.0-rc.1)**.
### Changed
- **The Biome Finder screen is a map.** Right-clicking the Biome Finder now shows a top-down map of the biomes around you, next to a searchable list of every biome in your dimension. Click a spot on the map or a name in the list to track it. - **An arrow points the way.** While you track a biome, a small arrowhead floats just ahead of your view and turns toward it, like a compass needle. It faces you while you glide, swim or crawl. Its textures live in `textures/misc/biome_finder_arrow/`, so resource packs can replace them. - **Clearing the target.** The biome you're tracking sits at the top of the screen with a ✕ to stop tracking it. Tracking also stops on its own once you walk into that biome.
### Upgrading from rc.3
- **Only the mod jar changed.** Keep the rc.3 apworld and your YAMLs.

entry.title: Pokemon XD Gale of Darkness v0.1.6
entry.content:
## New options - **Poke Spot Catch Checks** (On): turn it off to remove the "Catch –" checks for Pokemon found wild only at the Poke Spots. The spots still have their Pokemon. - **Mt. Battle Progression Checks** (0): with Exclude Mt. Battle Trainers off, each Mt. Battle trainer from 4 to 100 is a check. This many of them, counting from the first, can hold progression. The rest hold filler. - **Map Shows Trainer Levels** (On): the world map shows each place's trainer level on your first visit - **Single Master Ball** (On): turn it off to let extra Master Balls be in the filler pool - **Filler Weight: Master Ball** (0): weight for master balls if single master ball is off - **All Pokemon Learn All TMs** (Off): every Pokemon can learn every TM. - **Shadow Move TMs** (0): this many random TMs (up to 18) teach a Shadow move instead, each a different one. - **Start With Miror Radar and Poke Spots** (Off): start with the Miror Radar and the Poke Spots' unlock. Logic treats the Poke Spots, Miror B. and Shadow catches as open from the start. Needs Location Shuffle; with it off, this option is turned off. - **Missable Trainer Shadows** (Off): Shadows can also go on missable one-time trainers, whose checks are sent for you when their area is done. A Shadow you don't beat/catch goes to Miror B. Their catch checks never hold progression.
## Checks ### Added - **Gateon Port – Perr's Machine Part.** Sent when the story reaches Perr's scene at the parts shop, or once the story moves past it. It can hold progression. - **Mt. Battle – Defeat (trainer)**: 97 checks for trainers 4–100. They exist only in unique trainer-defeat mode with Exclude Mt. Battle Trainers off. ### Removed - **Numbered rematch checks.** Rematch fights no longer get their own "Defeat X #N" checks, except Naps #2, Smarton #2, Snattle #2, Gorigan #2 and Lovrina #2. Every "Defeat X (Any)" check stays. - **Kaminko Crane Room Chest 2.** It shares a flag with Chest 1, so the game can't hand out a second item from it.
## Logic - **Miror B. #2** is fought at the Outskirt Stand. "Defeat Miror B. (Any)" counts if you can reach the Poke Spots or the Outskirt Stand. - **Aferd, Laken and Hebon** are fixed and can hold progression, since they always battle when talked to. - **Missable one-time trainers the client sends for you** can hold progression too. With Missable Trainer Shadows on, they can also carry Shadows. - **Krane Memos 1–5** are all in the HQ Lab. Memos 3–5 need the Machine Part, or the Cipher Lab cleared with the Data ROM & ID Card. - **Acrod** is behind the System Lever. - **Ibsol, Jelstin and Fudler** are sent once Gorigan is defeated. They used to be sent the moment you entered the Key Lair. - **The Sixes' Shadows are only at the Cipher Lab.** At Phenac, that slot is an ordinary Pokemon of the same species. - **Fuzzer fix** for Location Shuffle seeds. ([#17](<https://github.com/GiovanavoiG/PokemonXD_Archipelago/issues/17>))
## Shadow Pokemon - **At most two Shadow moves.** Some late-game Shadows (Lugia, the birds, Citadark's) used to keep three or four after being randomized or moved. - **Every Shadow purifies normally, Lugia included.** - **Catch rates** - A randomized or swapped Shadow uses its new species' catch rate. A Lugia placed elsewhere is rate 3, then scaled by your settings. - Catch Rate Scaling now reaches every Shadow. - With Max Catch Rate on, the patcher checks that every Shadow ended up at 255. - **Missable Trainer Shadows** (new option, off by default) - When the trainer's area is done and its Shadow was never snagged, the client hands it to Miror B. and prints "X sent to Miror B. from a missable trainer." - Miror B. brings two Shadows at once at the Poke Spots whenever two or more are waiting. Normally that only happens at seven waiting. - `/missableshadows` lists them and what has been sent. - **Shadow catches are also read from the Shadow Monitor**, so a snagged Shadow counts wherever it went afterwards. - **Miror B.'s Cave Poke Spot Shadow can't be lost.** In the vanilla game, losing that fight means you never meet it again. Now the client hands it to Miror B.'s pool once the story is past it. - **Purifications are also read from the save's Shadow table.** A Shadow purified in the chamber, moved out of your party, or purified while the client was disconnected still counts, and never twice.
## NPCs - **Aferd, Laken and Hebon always battle when talked to.** Their teams still follow the story - **The Agate move tutor** offers all twelve moves from the start.
## Poke Spots - **All five Pokemon in a Poke Spotare equally likely**, about 20% each. That's its three regulars plus the two shared rare visitors. - **Wild catch hints** name the spot, e.g. "Cave Spot", or "Rock Spot, Oasis Spot or Cave Spot (rare visitor)". `/catches` shows the same. - **Stuck spots fixed.** Whiting out at a spot could leave a flag set that stops it spawning. The client now clears that flag once you've left.
## Story and travel - **HQ Lab memo hold** only holds the lab at the Krane Memo 3–5 step. Gateon's first visit, Perr's scene and the early Machine Part turn-in now play normally. - **Location Shuffle:** "Unlock – Realgam Tower" is sent the first time you stand in Phenac City. The HQ Lab moves on to the Purify Chamber scene after the Cipher Lab is cleared.
## Escape Rope - **Always in your Key Items.** Use it from the Bag and you go straight to the world map. - ⚠️ Using it mid-story (a cutscene area, the SS Libra, Citadark Isle) can leave the story somewhere it doesn't expect. **Save first.**
## Client - **No lost checks on a bad connection.** Checks found while the connection is down are re-sent until the server confirms them. Chests will likely still fail while disconnected. - **`/animations on|off`** turns move animations on or off on any patched ISO. The choice is remembered per slot. - **Saving over an older file no longer sends checks or completes your goal.** The client waits for the save data to settle before reading the story or travel record. - **`/pokespots`** shows each spot's snacks, waiting Pokemon, Miror B.'s location and more. - **Slot data carries every YAML option**, for trackers.
## Patching - **A missing file extension is added back.** If you forget the .iso/.ciso when naming your copy, the source disc's extension is used.
## Trainers and movesets - **Nightmare Greevil now replaces his real final battle.** It used to change only his post-game rematch, so the goal fight kept a normal randomized team. - **Trade Evolutions By Level** - Feebas upon reaching age 30 will strive towards beauty and grow into a big weird water snake fish eel. - **The Candy Box works in every seed.** You can getitem 99 candy boxes regardless of options. - **Icy Wind** shows up about half as often in trainer movesets.
## For tracker authors - Slot data includes every option that decides which locations exist or what logic needs, plus `purification_location_count`. - The client writes the current room id and area name to Data Storage on every room change. The keys are `pokemon_xd_room_{team}_{slot}` and `pokemon_xd_area_{team}_{slot}`, which slot data names as `room_id_key` and `room_area_key`.
## Known Issues - Rock spot is mean and breaks sometimes on location shuffle. Please report any findings.

entry.title: AEMinecraft v0.7.0r2
entry.content:
## AEMinecraft v0.7.0-rc.5
**Pre-release.** Fifth test build of v0.7.0. Stay on v0.6.2 if you want a stable game. rc.6 will be the last release candidate before v0.7.0, with a few more quality-of-life features.
This RC only lists what changed since the **[v0.7.0-rc.4 release notes](https://github.com/KuroLynx/AEMinecraft/releases/tag/v0.7.0-rc.4)**. For everything new in v0.7.0, see the **[v0.7.0-rc.1 release notes](https://github.com/KuroLynx/AEMinecraft/releases/tag/v0.7.0-rc.1)**.
Most of this RC comes from player reports. Thanks to everyone who sent them; every report was checked one by one.
### Hotfix (apworld re-uploaded 2026-10-23)
- **Generation could run out of memory and crash the PC.** A BACAP slot with glitch logic and every lock on used more than 11 GB while building its logic, and nothing was freed between Minecraft slots, so a multiworld with several of them ran the machine out of memory. The same slot now peaks around 3 GB, and each slot's memory is released before the next one starts. The logic and placements are unchanged: the same seed gives the same game as before. **If you downloaded the rc.5 apworld before this note, download it again.** The mod jars did not change.
### New options
- **`split_structure_variants`** (default `false`). Structures that only differ by biome now share one unlock: one `Structure Unlock: Village` opens all five villages, and the same goes for Ruined Portal (7), Ocean Ruin (2), Shipwreck (with beached), Mineshaft (with mesa) and, on 26.3, Abandoned Camp (18). The groups come from the game's own structure tags, so a datapack structure that joins one of those tags joins the group. The Structure Unlocks tab shows one tile per group and lays its tiles out as a full grid. Set it to `true` to get one item per variant, as before. - **`combat_logic`** (default `true`). A hard fight is only in logic once you have Sword or Axe Handling, Material Handling up to iron, a reliable food supply and, when `inventory_lock` locks armor slots, the first two of them. Hard fights are raids, the Trial Chambers' ominous challenge (Trial Omen, ominous vault) and bosses. Everything that goes through one inherits it, such as raid gifts. - **`exploration_logic`** (default `true`). An advancement that only asks you to go somewhere (Adventuring Time, Atlantis?, Subspace Bubble…) is only in logic once you have a reliable food supply (Hoe Handling, or one of Cow, Pig, Chicken, Sheep, Rabbit, Mooshroom, Cod or Salmon) and, with `inventory_lock`, a slot to carry it in. - Both logic options only change where items are placed. The tracker still shows such a check yellow when you could already try it. Set them to `false` for the old behaviour.
### Logic fixes
Status effects and potions - Status effects come from their real sources (mobs, food, beacons, stews, structures…) instead of "own a brewing stand". Darkness also comes from a Deep Dark's shriekers. - Splash and lingering potions are brewed properly (gunpowder, dragon's breath), so Noxious Fumes and Gas! need the End. A 14% Trial Chambers dispenser no longer counts as a reliable source. - A tipped arrow needs its lingering potion. - Suspicious stew effects come from every flower that gives them (I'm gonna be sick!). - Beacon effects need a beacon base.
Mobs and raids - Raid advancements follow the mod's raid gate, and only pillagers and raids make raid captains. - A banner with more layers than a loom can make is a raid captain's ominous banner (Superhero of the Village). - Raid gifts are an unreliable source with unknown odds. - Bees: honey and honeycomb need bees, a calm harvest needs a campfire, and honey bottles come from a full hive. - The Happy Ghast needs a dried ghast, so the Nether (Lead Zeppelin). - Trick or Treat! needs a mob that can actually wear a pumpkin. - The Camel Husk comes with its Husk; wolf armor needs a tamed wolf (Armadoggo, Good as New, Shear Brilliance). - Cured zombie villagers and igloo villagers count as villagers for every trade, even without a village. - Villager trades are an unreliable item source when villages are not locked behind an unlock. - Mob drops and structure loot of an unlock are reliable whatever the unlock's classification (leather, string: Help! I've been framed!, A Masterpiece!). - Elder Guardian and Piglin Brute drops run out; wet sponges dry in the Nether (Sponge Miner). - The ominous bottle: Trial Omen, Wind Burst and every item only the ominous vault or spawners hold need the Trial Chambers, a trial spawner mob and combat readiness.
Items, blocks and structures - Mining a tiered block needs a pickaxe of that tier. - A named enchantment's book comes from a librarian; random books are glitch only (Thin Ice!). An enchantment on an unnamed item asks for an item it can go on (Mace Windu), and the enchanting table only offers an enchantment on its primary items. - Archaeology loot needs a brush. - Wax scrapes off with an axe and crafted copper ages too (Lighten Up); aged copper blocks come from their plain block (Grate Expectations). - Stripped logs need an axe or a village/camp palette (Shelfception). - Dead coral needs living coral, and coral its Warm Ocean (Just a sample). - Rare structure palette blocks are glitch routes, e.g. the copper golem statue in 2-14% of camps (Such a poser). - An Overworld fossil's bone blocks are a glitch route (Boned, Paleontologist…). - Naturally generated blocks that also have a recipe read as natural, with the Biome Finder when rare. - Item colours ask for that dye (Colorful Cavalry). - On 26.3, structure lists and structure tags in advancement conditions are read properly (Raidin' Master, Atlantis?, Quicksand, Ahoy!). - New glitch routes: a Nether portal cast from water and lava, and string from a cobweb with a water bucket. - Each armor slot unlocks one at a time in logic, in the mod's order. - Fixed the replacement item used by item links, plando and start_inventory_from_pool. - Glitch logic is much smaller on BACAP (export 5.5 MB → 1.7 MB), so trackers and tools handle it faster.
### Mod fixes
- **Raids:** when a raid can't start, the game tells you which raid mobs are still locked. The ominous bottle can't be drunk within 32 blocks of an unlocked village or Trial Chambers whose raid or trial can't start yet, and it says why. - **Structures:** unlocked structures are rebuilt only into loaded chunks, without lag spikes or log spam (the mineshaft unlock lagged servers). Structures and mobs owed while a server was off are placed on the next start. - **Abandoned Camps** show on the Structure Finder bar with a campfire and a biome badge. - **Inventory lock:** inventory rows open from the hotbar up. Inventory Shuffle only shuffles unlocked slots. Dispensers can't put armor into a locked armor slot. - **keep_inventory** keeps its share of XP, and a totem of undying no longer loses the kept items. - **DeathLink:** `/aem deathlink mode random|all` picks whether a death kills one player or everyone on a server; saved in the world. - **Tracker:** checks under a hidden advancement re-parent to the nearest visible one, and a tab root with checks below it shows (gray). Goal tiles go gray on their own count and blue once collected. - The Biome Finder button follows the recipe book panel. - The BACAP rewards marker now lives in the world's `data/` folder. - `/aem dump` logs a failed pack dump and keeps it on screen, and the dump button writes every file.
### Upgrading from rc.4
- **Replace both the apworld and the mod jar.** Your YAMLs keep working; the three new options take their defaults. With the defaults, grouped structure unlocks shrink the item pool and the new logic options place combat and exploration progression a little later, so expect different seeds from the same YAML.

entry.title: Dwarf Fortress v2.1.2
entry.content:
A fix-only release. **2.1.x and 2.0.x seeds and worlds stay playable** - the item and location tables are untouched. The one exception is a skillsanity seed with combat skills turned off: those were generated broken (see below) and need regenerating.
### Removed checks
Two checks are no longer generated. Their ids stay registered, and an older seed that still has them gets them sent automatically, so their items are released.
- **Titan Slain.** Titans too rarely reach a fort for this to be a fair check; Forgotten Beast Slain still covers the first forgotten beast kill. - **Record Keeper skillsanity checks.** The skill barely trains in play, so its levels were close to unreachable. It is gone from the Medium and All skill groups and the manual skill list, and a yaml that still lists it is accepted with the skill ignored.
### Fixes
- **Fixed the Mountainhome goal and the Monarch Takes Residence check never firing.** Both looked for a KING or QUEEN noble position, but DF's dwarven monarch is the MONARCH position; king and queen are only its gendered names.
- **Fixed combat skill checks appearing with combat skillsanity turned off.** With skillsanity on and `skillsanity_enable_combat` off, the combat skills were never removed from the location list, so every combat skill was added at all 15 levels, ignoring the max level. Those checks had no logic rules and were missing from the client's skill tracking, so they could never be sent, and anything placed on them, progression included, was lost. Affected seeds are unwinnable and must be regenerated with this version. - **Fixed the gorlak caravan leaving AP goods behind.** A caravan's groups leave the map one at a time. Pack animals that had already left were mistaken for wild thieves and struck down, and goods they carried off were respawned in the depot where nobody collected them. When the caravan left, DF handed those goods to the fort, which counted as purchases (free checks) and left the items in the fort. Goods are now only created for a caravan that is arriving or trading, and units that have left the map are no longer treated as thieves. - **AP goods a caravan leaves behind, e.g. after being spooked, can be bought again.** The next gorlak caravan takes them over, lists them for sale and packs them up when it leaves. A purchase now only counts while a gorlak caravan is at the depot, so a good DF gives the fort after a caravan leaves is removed instead, and its slot comes back on a later visit. - **New AP goods belong to the gorlak caravan that is arriving or trading**, rather than whichever gorlak merchant was found first, which mattered in worlds with more than one gorlak civ. - **AP goods could never be removed.** DFHack refuses to remove items flagged as in a building, which every AP good is, so clearing goods, removing abandoned ones and reaping goods recovered from thieves all failed silently and retried forever. - **A Merchant's Coffer no longer summons the gorlaks when the shop is off.** The Legendary Wealth goal keeps coffers in the pool without the shop, and receiving one still forced a gorlak caravan with no AP goods, or, in a world without gorlaks, warned on every coffer that the shop could never work. The coffer now only counts toward the wealth goal.

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.18.4
entry.content: ## Changes ### Fixed - **The Docker stack generates the seed you set in the admin page.** Twelve run options never reached `make seed` or the self-hosted multiworld: mission modifiers and their minimum and maximum, the Australium Medal on clear, the Grappling Hook, cash rewards, the weapon-buff share and stack chance, the trap share, and bot cards with their starting count and mode. The seed was generated with their defaults whatever `.env` said. - **A seed with a community mission whose pack is not installed stops at Start.** The launcher used to start the run anyway, and you found out when the run switched to that mission, sometimes an hour in. Now the server stops as soon as it joins the room and names the mission and the pack to tick in Settings > Missions. - **Unticking a community pack takes its missions out of the run.** With the pack's ZIP on disk but unticked, Settings > Missions still showed its missions as Ready and the seed could draw them, though Start never installs an unticked pack, so the server then refused the seed. The missions now leave the pool and the page says to tick the pack. - **The tier menu and the mission count agree.** With SigMod ticked but not yet installed, the tier menu and the highest mission count you could pick counted different missions, 25 against 26 for the same settings. Both now count the same pool. - **A download site that is down no longer sends you to Repair.** When alliedmods.net or another site the install downloads from fails, the launcher now names the address and says to try again later. Repair would only have asked the same site again. - **A Valve mission loads with SigMod on.** Starting on Doe's Drill, or switching to any Valve mission on a map that also has community missions, could leave the server at wave 0 with "Could not find a valid population file" in the console. SigMod refuses a mission named in the first ten seconds of a map unless it is a loose file, and Valve's are not. The server now names the mission once those ten seconds are over. - **Taking an upgrade back no longer pays out every Cash Bundle again.** With cash rewards in the run, buying an upgrade and pressing minus at the station handed you all the bundle credits of the mission on top of the refund, every time. The minus button now gives back what the upgrade cost and nothing more. Refund All and a lost wave still keep your bundle credits. - **Two refunds at once no longer pay your Cash Bundles twice.** Refund All twice in a row, or Refund All as a wave is lost, gave your bundle credits back once per refund. With 800 in bundles, 400 came back as 2000 instead of 1200. They now come back once. - **Demoman bots reload their stickybomb launcher.** Once a Demoman had fired his stickies he never reloaded them, so against the next giant he was back to grenades. He also emptied the launcher on a lone robot or one standing right next to him, then never set the stickies off. He now keeps the launcher loaded between fights and only fires stickies he is going to detonate. A Demoman with nothing but stickies, on Booties or out of pipes, now sets them off on a single robot instead of letting it walk over them. - **Linux: a server missing `steamclient.so` says so instead of crashing.** Without it the game server dies at `replay_srv.so` on every start, and the launcher used to start it anyway. It now runs SteamCMD once to fetch the file, refuses the start with a message naming it if that fails, and the debug bundle's summary says where the link points and whether it works. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * docs(readme): keep the README to downloads and install links by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/223 * test(docker): refuse an image that drops the plugin's gamedata by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/224 * fix(plugin): stop the minus button paying the bundle ledger again by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/225 * chore(deps): tf2-mvm-bots-go v0.18.8 by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/226 * fix(launcher): refuse a Linux start with no steamclient.so link by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/228 * fix(plugin): name the mission once SigMod's vote guard is over by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/229 * fix: stop at Start for an uninstalled community pack, and at a failing download site by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/230 * fix(bridge): wait for the client to stop before a test's TempDir goes by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/232 * chore(deploy): pin floating image tags by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/231 * fix(docker): hand every run option to the seed containers by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/234 * refactor(plugin): own the grant cursor and the bundle ledger in grant_ledger.inc by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/235 * refactor(launcher): every mission question goes through availability by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/236 * refactor(plugin): own the weapon buff levels in weapon_buff_levels.inc by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/238 * chore(release): v1.18.4 by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/233 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.18.3...v1.18.4 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/N2RkMjE4YTMzODc3MWJjZjQ2ZTQyMTFhNjhmOWM4NGY6MTc5Mjc4NTUwMg==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/NTk3MmI5YmRlNmY2NDllN2E2OTQ4NjdhYTJhNTU1YzQ6MTc5Mjc4NTUwNA==/detection)

entry.title: Crystal Project v0.19.0

author.name: Dragons but also Rabbits, FabulaFey, Emerassi

entry.content:
### **Crystal Project v. 0.19.0 is out!** :tada: <https://github.com/Emerassi/CrystalProjectAPWorld/releases>
### Setup Guide <https://github.com/Emerassi/CrystalProjectAPWorld/blob/main/worlds/crystal_project/docs/setup_en.md>
### Find a Bug? Have a Suggestion? - Check if it's in here: <https://github.com/Emerassi/CrystalProjectAPWorld/issues> - If not, please add it! :> Thanks!
### New Features - Deathlink: This is for all the sickos out there who have grown tired of experiencing joy and can only truly feel something by inflicting pain on themselves and others. When you kill your friends, be sure to ask them what their game says happened, because deathlink lets us devs put whatever we want in the message =) - New Mystery Trap: We'll let it be a secret for now... but feel free to post about it as soon as you've seen it! - Homepoint Warp Counters: The region screen now lets you know how many homepoint warps you've unlocked in a region. Plot your heists with ease!
### Upgrades - Modern Mods: Decompiled version 1.6.9 of Crystal Project so we can now support mods with up to mod editor version 34. - Revamped Homepoint Icons: It should now be easier to tell categories of homepoints apart (e.g. filler/useful/progression/types of hints), as well as much more obvious whether or not a homepoint can be teleported to. If you've unlocked the warp, it will have a green circle under it. - Deterministic Generation: Our APWorld now generates entirely deterministically. Previously, some of the data structures we used were un-ordered, and as a result, re-using the exact same seed to generate could give you different results for starting jobs and for what traps were selected.
### Bug Fixes - If Shopsanity was enabled and regions included Advanced or greater, previously some of the items that should have been showing up were missing! And it was the most powerful ones! Math error corrected. You'll see less filler and more real items now. - No longer possible for Sequoia Athenaeum to be your starting region. It is (almost) impossible to collect any checks inside it without access to the outside, so that you can push the ice block in through the door. - Earned Item Info Mode sometimes failed to start showing item information.
### KNOWN ISSUES - Only works on the Steam version - Receiving a passive point cap increase does not update the available passive points until a passive is toggled on or off. - Mods that change the text scrolls (such as the intro in spawning meadows) may result in unexpected behavior. - If Crystal Project (the game not this mod) ever updates beyond version 1.6.9, any newly updated non-Archipelago mods will not work (this has always been true every time it updates until we release a new version of the Archipelago mod).

- Requires [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest). Make sure you are up-to-date. - Download the `.apworld` file below and double-click it to install. Restart Archipelago after installation. - Use **Options Creator** or **Generate Template Options** in the Archipelago Launcher to create player option YAML files. - Place your edited player option YAML files in the `Players` folder. Use **Browse Files...** in the Launcher to open the Archipelago directory. - Make sure you have all required `.apworld` files, your player YAMLs, and any desired `host.yaml` settings ready before generating. (`server_password` is recommended for admin login.) - Click **Generate** to create a multiworld `.zip` in the `output` folder. - Upload the generated `.zip` to https://archipelago.gg/uploads or self-host it. Self-hosting requires port forwarding. - For detailed setup instructions and game-specific documentation, see [game-specific documentation](https://github.com/Panguu/Archipelago-RaCSM/tree/SM-Main/worlds/rac_size_matters/docs). - If you encounter errors, run `ArchipelagoLauncherDebug.exe` or launch Archipelago from a terminal and check the `logs` folder. - Need help? Join the Archipelago Discord: https://discord.gg/8Z65BR2

entry.title: wizardoflegend v1.1.0
entry.content:
## [1.1.0] - V1.1.0 Release
### Added - "Teleport to Hub" button in the pause menu to quickly reroll the dungeon. - Perfect boss / miniboss locations, with bosses being optional. - New NPC's Tokens progression item added. - New trap system that queues traps instead of triggering them all at once. - Game items are now reintroduced in shops when no Archipelago locations are left available.
### Changed - Reworked archipelago items by bundling relics and arcanas to have less items. - Rebalanced the APWorld: reduced grindy locations and diversified traps. - NPC locations are now locked behind their associated token requirement. - Refactored `ItemHandler`. - Removed the BouncyCastle proxy dependency.
### Fixed - Max HP Boost no longer resets the player's health when picking a relic inside the dungeon. - Removed potential in-game freezes while sending checks by sending them to the server in a separate thread. - Loop NPC not appearing. - Level locations are now correctly checked even if the player cannot go to the next level. - Group Relics no longer behave erratically. - Various fixes following playtesting, including the Perfect miniboss bug, shop slots and the Collector NPC.
### AI Disclosure - AI assistance was used for learning BepInEx/Harmony modding patterns, and supporting code refactoring. The vast majority of the codebase was authored by hand..
